mapper.sql: att.user_id, u.nickname, u.student_no, u.college, att.checked_in_at, att.volunteer_hours, att.method
mapper.select: SELECT FROM activity_attendance att INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = att.user_id WHERE att.activity_id = #{activityId} ORDER BY att.checked_in_at ASC, att.id ASC

SELECT att.activity_id, a.title, c.name AS club_name, a.location, a.start_time, a.end_time, att.checked_in_at, att.volunteer_hours, att.method FROM activity_attendance att INNER JOIN activity a ON a.id = att.activity_id INNER JOIN club c ON c.id = a.club_id WHERE att.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY att.checked_in_at DESC, att.id DESC
